# Field Notes

Portable notes on CommonMark-compliant formatting. This document is already good: consistent headings, single H1, no skipped levels, plain portable constructs only.

## Paragraphs

Paragraphs are separated by blank lines. Inline code like `npm install` and identifiers like `WidgetHooks` stay untouched.

## Lists

- Unordered items use a single marker style.
- Nested items indent consistently.

1. Ordered items are sequential.
2. The numbering is deliberate.

## Links and images

See [the CommonMark spec](https://spec.commonmark.org/).

![Diagram of a paragraph flow](./docs/images/paragraph-flow.png)

## Conclusion

Nothing here needs to change. The skill should recognize an already-good portable document and leave it alone.
